description: Candidate source lane for the on-demand secure-work cycle CLI, Python engine and fixed M10 custody bridge. M10 carries the existing IngressClient and its pinned SDK dependency closure; custody_runtime_binding.json remains null until independently bound installation authority exists. E14/E13 kit, Python venv, job/vault/outbox state, actual bindings and credentials remain external. This spec does not activate or register a lane.

carried_forward_rationale.ui-workspace/node_modules/: custody_bridge.mjs imports the existing dev-erp-mcp IngressClient, which imports @modelcontextprotocol/sdk client/index.js and client/streamableHttp.js. Reuse the version-pinned Tongs dependency staging procedure: a separately prepared dependency-only directory with its own LANE_MANIFEST.sha256 must contain the complete SDK runtime closure resolved by the committed ui-workspace package lock. Do not inherit arbitrary installed lanes or their credentials. The previous placeholder is no longer a runtime-closure claim. Source-lane generation verifies inherited bytes; Python/kit and immutable launcher/transitive integrity remain separate uncompleted installation contracts.
